title: The Bog Light
text: A light bobs over the marsh, just ahead, always just ahead, soft and blue as a candle behind a curtain. It waits when you stop. It goes the way you were going anyway, which is either very kind of it, or not kind at all.

options.label: Follow the blue light, and trust it knows the way through.

outcomes.text: It leads you through the marsh by a dry path no map shows, and winks out at the end, satisfied.
It leads you into the deep water, and waits, and watches to see who comes to watch you drown.

options.label: The quickest tries to catch it in a jar, before it can lead anyone astray.

outcomes.text: It is in the jar, beating against the glass, very angry and very bright.
It is not in the jar. It is behind them, very close, and then it is gone, and they cannot stop shaking.

options.label: Keep to your own way, and ignore its soft invitation.

outcomes.text: It sulks off over the water, and the mist it leaves behind is the kind that settles in the lungs.
